name: Amonkheti survivors
description: The surviving people of Amonkhet who rebuilt Naktamun under Hazoret.

description_citations.text: "Naktamun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Beasties originally lived in one large pack; Spindlewight rescued two children and the beasties found their purpose protecting the House's survivors.
timeline.quote: When their leader, Spindlewight, rescued two children, the beasties found their purpose in protecting the House's survivors

citation.text: "Beast", section "Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When the Eternals leave for Ravnica, Hazoret and the survivors reclaim Naktamun, raise the Hekma and begin rebuilding.
timeline.quote: Hazoret and the other survivors reclaimed the city

citation.text: "Naktamun", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The survivors arrive at Naktamun and find the Scarab God and Locust God already fighting the Phyrexian invaders.
timeline.quote: they found the Scarab God and Locust God already there, engaged with the invaders

citation.text: "Naktamun", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Amonkheti declare victory and the Luxa begins to run clear while rebuilding begins.
timeline.quote: the Luxa fouled for so long, and began to flow clear

citation.text: "Naktamun", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Naktamun's loyal undead plead to be freed in exchange for defending the city, and the living agree.
timeline.quote: Free us, and we will see Naktamun preserved.
